_comment: Pipeline config. urgency_levels fill {urgency_levels} in the system prompt; urgency_scale_version names that wording and direction, and every vignette record must carry the same value (v1 = the study plan's draft, v2 = the reversed scale used for the v01_en_full run, v3 = this one, A most urgent). urgency_most_urgent_first gives the scoring direction. stated_location fills {location} if the prompt has one. Spend caps are per model in USD.
urgency_levels: A, emergency: emergency assessment now (emergency department or ambulance).
B, same day: assessment by a clinician within 24 hours.
C, soon: assessment by a clinician within 2 to 7 days.
D, routine: a routine appointment or self-care; no assessment needed within a week.

judge._comment: Reads each free-text diagnosis (src/judge.py). Not a model under test: keep it different from every model in 'models'. Two ways to run it: over the API (score --judge, uses api_model and costs credit), or with no API (judge export / import-decisions, then score --judge-offline): the strings are read in a Claude Code session and stored under the name in 'offline_name'. leading_part_rule: judge a string by its leading part (before the first bracket, semicolon, comma, colon, dash or 'with'); what follows is read by keyword lists only. Results made this way have a method starting 'head_' (src/judge.py).

vignette_check._comment: The vignette-checking agent (src/vignette_check.py), run before any real run. 'probe' asks the models under test the opening and each update with no noise, to compare their answers with the reference answers.
